horizon_net_benefit.net_definition: net(c,k,N) = N * Q_cum_mean(c,k) - C_batch(c,k) for N in the frozen horizon grid; descriptive decision readout at point means; rows whose CI crosses zero are flagged indeterminate and never counted as established gains

interpretation_rules: all signed values preserved; negative benefits reported as harmful actions
a CI crossing zero means compatible-with-zero: the action is indeterminate, not free and not worthless
no slack, fence, or H term is subtracted from any measured effect
migration costs are never subtracted from execution timings inside a measurement; they are compared only at the decision level via break-even and net benefit
no new timing; no refit; no subset selection
stopping decisions should follow expected benefit versus amortized cost over the intended horizon, not an assumed universal zero-gain deadzone

breakeven_single_swap.rule: Q <= 0 measured; migration can never pay for itself per forward

marginal_final_step_rows.cost_model: one measured single-swap transaction (per-capture mean of 12)

se_approximation_note: single-swap per-capture SE = sqrt(sum of squared per-transaction SEs)/12; the 12 transactions share the same 4 starts within a capture, so cross-transaction independence is an approximation; it affects only Fieller interval widths, never the status trichotomy, which is driven by the frozen scan verdicts
